china-handbook-1926:p0737_1.rationale: Compares transport media (railways, steamboats, junks, carts, pack animals) by average load, daily mileage, cost per ton-mile and maximum haul; the cost per ton-mile is the main comparative measure.
review_questions: A tag for general comparison of transport modes is missing from the vocabulary.

china-handbook-1926:p0739_1.rationale: Vessels entered and cleared at Nanking by flag, split into ocean steamers, river steamers and other vessels, with number and tonnage.

china-handbook-1926:p0739_2.rationale: Vessels entered and cleared at Chinkiang by flag and vessel class, with number and tonnage.

china-handbook-1926:p0739_3.rationale: Vessels entered and cleared at Wuhu by flag and vessel class, with number and tonnage.

china-handbook-1926:p0740_1.rationale: Electric-light plants by location, listing capacity in kilowatts, rates and equipment origin.

china-handbook-1926:p0741_1.rationale: Values of imports and exports at Nanking, Chinkiang and Wuhu for 1913, 1923 and 1924.

china-handbook-1926:p0742_1.rationale: Quantity and value of principal exports (beans, cereals, eggs, seeds, silk) through the Maritime Customs, by year.

china-handbook-1926:p0742_2.rationale: Quantity and value of principal imports (cigarettes, cotton, metals, kerosene, sugar) by year.

china-handbook-1926:p0745_1.rationale: Land purchase prices and rents for office, warehouse and residential space in Nanking sections. This is real-estate pricing, which no existing tag covers.
review_questions: Propose a tag for property values and rents.

china-handbook-1926:p0747_1.rationale: Estimated populations of leading cities in the Swatow district, with counts of resident Europeans and Americans.
